title: Match: Hollow Pulse
brief: Match this sound: a narrow, buzzy pulse, held steady. Press "Play target" to hear it. Build a VCO straight into the Output — no filter this time, so the only thing that can be wrong is the waveform itself. Try the Shape knob's four positions first and find Pulse; then turn the Width knob well away from its centered default, toward one edge — the narrower the pulse gets, the more of its harmonic series drops out, and the more hollow and buzzy it sounds next to a full sawtooth.
